PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Selection Process 2026
Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is scheduled to be held on 26 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they reach the venue on time with all necessary documents.

faq.question: Q2. What is the total number of vacancies announced for Contractual Teachers?
faq.answer: The official notification indicates 0 vacancies for the Contractual Teachers posts. It is advisable to check the detailed notification for any updates or specific requirements.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application fee for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is no application fee for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. Candidates can attend the walk-in interview without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q4. What are the minimum qualifications required for the Primary Teacher post?
faq.answer: For the Primary Teacher post, candidates need Senior Secondary (10+2) with 50% marks and a 2-year Diploma in Elementary Education or B.El.Ed or Diploma in Special Education, along with CTET Paper-I qualification.

faq.question: Q5. Is there any specific educational qualification for the ATL Instructor post?
faq.answer: Yes, for the ATL Instructor position, candidates must possess a B.E./B.Tech in Electronic & Communication Engineering with at least one year of experience in innovation, robotics, STEM, or AI.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these contractual positions?
faq.answer: The selection process primarily involves a Walk-in Interview followed by Document Verification. Candidates need to perform well in the interview to be considered for the positions.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview for PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya Recruitment 2026 going to be held?
faq.answer: The interview will be conducted at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya, Chhatarpur, Madhya Pradesh, PIN 471001. Candidates must report to the specified venue on the interview date.

faq.question: Q8. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry all original documents, including ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if applicable), and category certificates, along with one set of self-attested photocopies.

faq.question: Q9. Are there any age relaxations mentioned for the candidates?
faq.answer: The provided data does not specify age limits or relaxations. Candidates are advised to refer to the official notification for detailed information regarding age criteria.

faq.question: Q10. What is the job type for the advertised positions?
faq.answer: The positions advertised are on a contractual basis. This means the employment is for a fixed term as per the terms and conditions of the recruitment.
